name: test-triage.nux.opus.1
result:
I ran the suite with `node --test` and wrote `answer.json`; it's the only file I changed. The runner reported 400 tests: 394 passed, 3 failed, 2 were skipped and 1 is marked todo.

The three failing tests, with the message each assertion gives:

| File | Test | Message |
|---|---|---|
| `test/mod07.test.js` | parses dates in March | March 31 should stay in March |
| `test/mod22.test.js` | rounds half up | 2.5 should round to 3 |
| `test/mod35.test.js` | keeps order of equal keys | equal keys must keep their order |

The two skipped tests are "slow path of mod04" and "slow path of mod30". The todo test is "streams large files".

All three failures come from the same line: `assert.equal(1, 2, '<message>')`. Each one compares two fixed numbers that are never equal, so these tests fail every time no matter what the code does. The runner also prints `1 !== 2` after each message; I left that out because it's Node's comparison of the values, not text the test supplies.
